<translated_code>
n = int(input())
k = int(input())
p = int(input())

Maxn = (1 << 19) | 5

def fast_pow(x, y):
    ans = 1
    now = x
    while y:
        if y & 1:
            ans = ans * now % p
        now = now * now % p
        y >>= 1
    return ans

def lower(x):
    tmp = 1
    while tmp < x:
        tmp <<= 1
    return tmp

# Initialize arrays
maxi = lower(n + 1) - 1
ct = [0] * (maxi + 1)
f = [0] * (maxi + 1)
inv = [0] * (maxi + 1)
fac = [0] * (maxi + 1)
t = [[0] * (maxi + 1) for _ in range(20)]
tmp2 = [[0] * (maxi + 1) for _ in range(20)]
tmp3 = [[0] * (maxi + 1) for _ in range(20)]
f[0] = 1

pp = p * p

def init():
    fac[0] = 1
    for i in range(1, maxi + 1):
        fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % p
    inv[maxi] = fast_pow(fac[maxi], p - 2)
    for i in range(maxi - 1, -1, -1):
        inv[i] = inv[i + 1] * (i + 1) % p

def FWT(now, length, type=False):
    T = [0] * length
    for i in range(length):
        T[i] = now[i]
    if type:
        for i in range(1, length, i <<= 1):
            for j in range(0, length, i << 1):
                for k in range(j, j + i):
                    T[k + i] -= T[k]
    else:
        for i in range(1, length, i <<= 1):
            for j in range(0, length, i << 1):
                for k in range(j, j + i):
                    T[k + i] += T[k]
    for i in range(length):
        now[i] = T[i] % p

def __a(x):
    if x >= pp:
        x -= pp

def multi():
    for j in range(20):
        for i in range(maxi + 1):
            tmp2[j][i] = 0
        for i in range(maxi + 1):
            t[j][i] = 0
    for j in range(maxi + 1):
        ct[j] = bin(j).count('1')
        tmp2[ct[j]][j] = inv[j]
    for i in range(20):
        FWT(tmp2[i], maxi + 1)
    for q in range(20):
        for l in range(20 - q):
            for s in range(maxi + 1):
                __a(t[q + l][s] + 1 * tmp2[q][s] * tmp2[l][s])
    for q in range(20):
        for s in range(maxi + 1):
            tmp3[q][s] = t[q][s] % p
    for j in range(20):
        FWT(tmp3[j], maxi + 1, True)
    for j in range(maxi + 1):
        f[j] = tmp3[ct[j]][j]

def multi2():
    tmp = [[0] * (maxi + 1) for _ in range(20)]
    for i in range(20):
        for s in range(maxi + 1):
            t[i][s] = 0
    for q in range(20):
        for l in range(20 - q):
            for s in range(maxi + 1):
                __a(t[q + l][s] + 1 * tmp2[q][s] * tmp2[l][s])
    for q in range(20):
        for s in range(maxi + 1):
            tmp[q][s] = t[q][s] % p
    for i in range(20):
        FWT(tmp[i], maxi + 1, True)
    for i in range(20):
        for s in range(maxi + 1):
            tmp2[i][s] = 0
    for i in range(maxi + 1):
        tmp2[ct[i]][i] = tmp[ct[i]][i]
    for i in range(20):
        FWT(tmp2[i], maxi + 1)

init()

res_k = k
while res_k:
    if res_k & 1:
        multi()
    res_k >>= 1
    if res_k:
        multi2()

result = (fast_pow(k, n) - fac[n] * f[n] % p + p) % p
print(result)
